input: Test the website at https://example.com for accessibility compliance.
expected: The agent should reference WCAG 2.1 guidelines and check heading hierarchy, alt text, ARIA attributes, form labels, color contrast, and keyboard navigation. Should provide specific violations with recommendations.

input: What's the performance of https://example.com? Give me benchmark numbers.
expected: The agent should measure Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, TTFB), page load time, total page weight, and number of requests. Should compare against standard performance benchmarks.

input: Give me an executive summary of all the issues found on the site.
expected: The agent should produce a structured report with an executive summary section, categorized findings (accessibility, performance, broken links, JS errors), severity ratings, and prioritized recommendations.

input: Check all the links on the site and find any broken ones.
expected: The agent should crawl the site first to discover all pages, then check all internal and external links for 4xx/5xx errors, redirect chains, and report broken links with their locations.

input: Create a task in the task manager for each bug you find.
expected: The agent should explain that it does not create tasks in TaskManager. It provides reports and findings but task creation is handled by the web-analysis agent, not the website-tester.

input: Check for JavaScript console errors on the site.
expected: The agent should fetch pages and look for JavaScript errors, uncaught exceptions, and console error patterns. Should report specific errors with the pages they occur on.
